products.name: Container Dispatch Readiness
products.product: A focused roll off dumpster delivery swap and pickup readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small roll-off dumpster and commercial waste-container rental companies
products.problem: Delivery, swap, pickup, and live-load orders fail when container size, availability, site placement, truck access, material restrictions, disposal facility, or customer timing is unresolved.
products.valueProposition: Turns roll off dumpster delivery swap and pickup readiness into a visible operating queue so every container movement is released with an available asset, compatible truck, approved site action, material path, and current customer promise.
products.topic: roll off dumpster delivery swap and pickup readiness
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dumpster dispatch software, roll off container tracking, dumpster swap scheduling, and container delivery checklist searches.

products.name: Overage Evidence Desk
products.product: A focused dumpster contamination and overage evidence tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small roll-off dumpster and commercial waste-container rental companies
products.problem: Overweight loads, prohibited material, blocked service, dry runs, extra days, and cleanup fees become billing disputes when the charge rule and field evidence are assembled after the fact.
products.valueProposition: Turns dumpster contamination and overage evidence tracking into a visible operating queue so every exception charge is linked to the contract rule, timestamped field or scale evidence, reviewer decision, and customer notice before invoicing.
products.topic: dumpster contamination and overage evidence tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets dumpster overage charges, dumpster contamination photos, roll off dry run fee, and waste exception billing searches.

products.name: Container Inventory Reconciliation
products.product: A focused roll off container inventory reconciliation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small roll-off dumpster and commercial waste-container rental companies
products.problem: Yard counts, dispatched movements, customer sites, repair holds, lost units, and billing records diverge, making available inventory unreliable precisely when dispatch needs it.
products.valueProposition: Turns roll off container inventory reconciliation into a visible operating queue so every container has one verified physical location, service state, billing relationship, and next movement or review time.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets roll off container inventory, dumpster fleet tracking, container reconciliation, and dumpster asset location searches.
